map.计算压缩率与压缩比，评估压缩效果。: Compute the compression ratio and rate from original and compressed sizes to quantify compression effectiveness.
map.压缩率越接近 100% 压缩越强。: The closer the rate is to 100%, the stronger the compression.
map.存储优化评估：比较不同算法对日志/备份的压缩率。: Storage optimization: compare compression rates of different algorithms on logs/backups.
map.传输成本核算：估算压缩后报文节省的带宽。: Transfer cost: estimate bandwidth saved by compressed messages.
map.格式选型：对同类数据横向比较 gzip/zstd/zip 效果。: Format selection: compare gzip/zstd/zip effects on similar data.
map.压缩率=(1−压缩后/原始)×100% 表示节省比例；压缩比=原始/压缩后表示体: Rate = (1 - compressed/original) x 100% is the saved fraction; ratio = original/compressed is the volume multiple.
map.据无冗余，加压缩头反而略增，属正常。: has no redundancy, and the compression header adds a bit; that is normal.
map.压缩率越高越省空间，但需权衡 CPU 与耗时，实时场景未必划算。: Higher rate saves more space but trades CPU and time; real-time scenarios may not be worth it.
